scientific_integrity: The Fourier block trace norm is weighted by irreducible dimensions; the regular-representation and finite cosine identities are openly acknowledged as standard ingredients. All-group proof is analytic; finite tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two nonzero sites and finite groups; no extensions to higher sparsity, noise, or other Fourier norms. Nonindexed older equivalent identities remain a residual priority risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: Opposite arithmetic extremizers for two-site Fourier trace ratios on finite groups
